title: Help the Church while you shop
content:
Did you know you can earn money for EHBC through Kroger Community Rewards?  Quarterly, Kroger sends our church a check from this program. 
 From August to November, we had 39 families participating and Kroger sent us a check for $225.70.  
If you are interested and need help signing up send an email to Jina Wells at ehbcjeff@gmail.com and she will help you with the process.
